……というわけで、最後までドタバタしましたけど、\n何とか申請をしてチームとして: ...And so, while it was hectic right up until the very end, we somehow managed to submit the application and get officially recognized as a team.

みーんな、なんかの形でちゃーんと保存してるんだよね♪\nふふ、ラミちゃんなんて、: Every～one saved it in their own way♪ Fufu, Rami-chan even made it her device wallpaper!

ふふ、仲が良いですわね。: Fufu, you two really get along well.

うわぁ……またあのモードに入っちゃったよ……: Ugh... He went into that mode again...
